text.en: Clients express immense gratitude to Lisa, Nicola, Tony, and the daycare team for creating a welcoming family environment. Dog owners highlight that the staff treat every dog like their own, going above and beyond to provide dependable and loving care. Reviewers frequently describe the facility as a trusted second home for their pets while at work.

Pet owners appreciate the attentive, individualized care provided to small and medium dogs throughout daycare days. Clients note that staff take time to understand the unique personality and temperament of each dog, ensuring nervous or timid pets feel safe and secure. Reviewers highlight that dogs arrive eager to play and return home calm, relaxed, and happy.

Reviewers report excellent socialization results, noting that attending daycare helps their dogs become more confident, friendly, and well-adjusted around other animals. Pet owners value that dogs come home content and thoroughly relaxed after structured indoor and outdoor playtime. Clients frequently remark on the positive behavioural impact on their pets.

q.en: Does Chilled Dawgz offer pet collection or drop-off services?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight the convenient home drop-off service, which provides vital support for shift workers.

q.en: What size dogs are accepted at the daycare?

a.en: The daycare specializes exclusively in small to medium dogs up to 20kg to maintain a safe, balanced playgroup.

q.en: How are anxious or nervous dogs supported at Chilled Dawgz?

a.en: Staff make extra efforts to help anxious dogs settle in with gentle handling, ensuring they feel secure and confident.

q.en: Are both indoor and outdoor play areas available?

a.en: Yes, reviewers praise the clean indoor and outdoor facilities designed for safe exercise and rest.
